segment.delete: after every event it carried is acked, nacked or dropped
segment.directory: a real directory, owned by root or the agent, closed to others (no o+rwx), readable and writable by the agent (under a unit's ReadWritePaths), fed by one source; otherwise the source is refused at boot. A segment is owned by the agent, root or the directory's owner, or carries the directory's group (a setgid directory gives it)

emitter_bound.rule: the emitter deletes its oldest segments past either bound; the agent reads only while its integration is live and acks arrive, so this is the spool's only bound when they do not

record.fields: the kind's declared fields at top level, scalar values only
record.kind: string, a kind the source declares
record.ts: string, optional, RFC 3339 UTC with Z; the agent stamps it when absent

segment.refusals: an unknown schema is refused whole, each of its events counted; an oversize, foreign-owned or irregular segment is refused whole and counted once; an event over max_record_bytes, with an undeclared kind or field, an envelope field or a non-scalar or non-finite value is refused; counts land in dropped_events.undeclared
segment.write: write a dot-named temp file in the spool directory, fsync, rename

metrics.push._note: jobs is omitted, never null, when the agent runs no job manager
